user.title: Add a Grandstream phone
user.description: Enter the handset's IP address or hostname. Its web interface must be turned on (handset menu: Settings → Advanced → Security). A DHCP reservation for the handset is recommended.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. The integration connects over HTTPS.

credentials.title: Log in to the {model}
credentials.description: Use the handset's `user` web account if you can: it can do everything this integration needs except read battery status, and it can't change security settings. Turn it on and set its password in the handset's web interface (System Settings → Security). The admin account also works.

data_description.username: `user` or `admin`. These names are fixed by the handset.
data_description.password: The handset locks the account after 5 failed logins.

unverified_model.title: Untested model: {model}
unverified_model.description:
This integration has only been tested on: {verified}. The {model} answered like a supported handset, so it will probably work, but some settings or status may be missing or wrong.

If you continue, please report how it goes, with a diagnostics download attached: {report_url}

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to the {model} again
reauth_confirm.description: The handset at {host} rejected the saved credentials. Polling has stopped so repeated attempts don't lock the account.

data_description.password: The handset locks the account after 5 failed logins.

reconfigure.title: Change the {model}'s address
reconfigure.description: Enter the handset's new IP address or hostname. The saved credentials are reused.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Grandstream handset there. Check the address, that the handset is on Wi-Fi, and that its web interface is turned on.
error.invalid_auth: The handset rejected that username or password.
error.invalid_auth_attempts: The handset rejected that username or password. {attempts_left} attempts left before it locks the account.
error.account_locked: The handset has locked this account after too many failed logins. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
error.user_access_disabled: Web access for the `user` account is turned off. Turn it on in the handset's web interface (System Settings → Security), or log in as `admin`.

abort.already_configured: This handset is already configured. Its address has been updated if it changed.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different handset.

write_rejected.message: The handset did not apply the change ({keys}). The account may not be allowed to change that setting.

auth_failed.message: The handset rejected the saved credentials. Re-authenticate the integration.

confirm.title: Take over {name}'s event URLs?
confirm.description:
These event URLs on {name} already point somewhere else ({hosts}): {events}. This is usually another Home Assistant instance that also has this handset, or a URL set by hand. Until they point here, those events reach this instance only through polling.

Taking over replaces them with this instance's URLs, and whatever they pointed at stops receiving those events. Only do this if the other destination no longer needs them.

no_url.title: {name}: no local URL for pushed events
no_url.description: The handset needs a local address to send events to, and Home Assistant doesn't have one it can use. Set a local network URL under Settings → System → Network. Until then, {name} is polled only.
